title: Java Vega - Una bicicleta de Triatlón - Zona3

takeaways.text: Full carbon (Toray T700/T800) frame with full L-TWOO R9 electronic 2×12, 80 mm Decap front wheel, disc rear wheel and 160 mm hydraulic brakes.
The cockpit adjusts in height, width and reach, and shift buttons sit on both the extensions and the base bar.
The derailleurs charge by USB-C; 28 mm tires come with tubes on tubeless-ready rims, and the seat clamp gives wide fore-aft adjustment.

disclosure: Filmed in a Chilean shop that sold the bike; Spanish automatic captions.
summary: A Chilean shop walkaround of the JAVA Vega triathlon bike with L-TWOO R9 electronic shifting.
